views.name: users_basic_profile
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  Reputation,
  CreationDate,
  DisplayName,
  LastAccessDate,
  WebsiteUrl,
  Location,
  AboutMe,
  Views,
  UpVotes,
  DownVotes,
  AccountId,
  Age,
  ProfileImageUrl
FROM users
views.description: Normalized user profile rows with core attributes and deterministic typed columns. Use to join user info to posts, comments, votes, badges. Cleans nothing that isn't explicit; preserves original column names. | Use for: Enrich posts/comments/votes with user attributes; Filter users by reputation/age/location or compute user cohorts; User lifetime and activity analyses (last access, views)

views.name: posts_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  PostTypeId,
  AcceptedAnswerId,
  CreaionDate,
  Score,
  ViewCount,
  Body,
  OwnerUserId,
  LasActivityDate,
  Title,
  Tags,
  AnswerCount,
  CommentCount,
  FavoriteCount,
  LastEditorUserId,
  LastEditDate,
  CommunityOwnedDate,
  ParentId,
  ClosedDate,
  OwnerDisplayName,
  LastEditorDisplayName
FROM posts
views.description: One row per post with core attributes and measures, preserving original column names (note: uses provided column names including their spelling). Use as the canonical posts relation for joins and aggregations. | Use for: Question/answer counts and trends; Filtering posts by type, owner, dates, or tags (downstream text parsing); Joining post metrics to users, comments, votes, or tags

views.name: comments_by_post
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  PostId,
  COUNT(*) AS comment_count,
  SUM(Score) AS comment_score_sum,
  AVG(Score) AS comment_score_avg,
  MIN(CreationDate) AS first_comment_creationdate,
  MAX(CreationDate) AS last_comment_creationdate
FROM comments
GROUP BY PostId
views.description: Aggregated comment measures per PostId: count of comments, avg and sum of comment Score, most recent comment date, and first comment date. Useful when joining comment metrics to posts without exploding rows. | Use for: Compare posts by comment activity; Time-to-first-comment or recency analyses; Filter posts with no comments or very active comment threads

views.name: votes_by_post_and_type
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  PostId,
  VoteTypeId,
  COUNT(*) AS votes_count,
  SUM(BountyAmount) AS votes_bounty_sum
FROM votes
GROUP BY PostId, VoteTypeId
views.description: Counts and sum of bounty amounts of votes grouped by PostId and VoteTypeId. Use when you need per-post vote-type breakdowns (upvotes, downvotes, accepts, bounties) without joining raw votes. | Use for: Vote type distributions per post; Aggregate bounty awarded per post; Join vote-type counts to posts for score reconstructions

views.name: badges_per_user
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  UserId,
  COUNT(*) AS badge_count,
  MIN(Date) AS first_badge_date,
  MAX(Date) AS last_badge_date
FROM badges
GROUP BY UserId
views.description: Badge counts per user and most recent badge award date. Useful for profiling users by badges and joining badge-derived features to user analyses. | Use for: Segment users by badge counts or recency; Correlate badges with reputation/activity

views.name: posts_with_user_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.Id,
  p.PostTypeId,
  p.AcceptedAnswerId,
  p.CreaionDate,
  p.Score,
  p.ViewCount,
  p.Body,
  p.OwnerUserId,
  p.LasActivityDate,
  p.Title,
  p.Tags,
  p.AnswerCount,
  p.CommentCount,
  p.FavoriteCount,
  p.LastEditorUserId,
  p.LastEditDate,
  p.CommunityOwnedDate,
  p.ParentId,
  p.ClosedDate,
  p.OwnerDisplayName,
  p.LastEditorDisplayName,
  u.Reputation AS Reputation,
  u.CreationDate AS CreationDate,
  u.DisplayName AS DisplayName,
  u.LastAccessDate AS LastAccessDate,
  u.WebsiteUrl AS WebsiteUrl,
  u.Location AS Location,
  u.AboutMe AS AboutMe,
  u.Views AS Views,
  u.UpVotes AS UpVotes,
  u.DownVotes AS DownVotes,
  u.AccountId AS AccountId,
  u.Age AS Age,
  u.ProfileImageUrl AS ProfileImageUrl
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
views.description: Denormalized posts joined to their owner user record (when OwnerUserId exists). Preserves all post columns and attaches user fields for enrichment. Use this for queries that need both post and owner attributes without separate joins. | Use for: Compare post metrics by owner reputation or age; Filter posts by owner attributes (location, reputation, account age); Prepare training data combining post text/metrics with user signals

views.name: post_comment_counts_ranked
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  PostId,
  comment_count,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY comment_count DESC, PostId ASC) AS comment_count_rank
FROM (
  SELECT PostId, COUNT(*) AS comment_count
  FROM comments
  GROUP BY PostId
) t
views.description: Per-post comment count with a dense rank ordered by comment_count descending and tie-handling; exposes rank so downstream queries can select top-K posts by comments by filtering rank. Deterministic ordering within ties uses PostId. | Use for: Top-K posts by comment activity; Identify highly-discussed posts for moderation or highlighting

views.name: user_activity_time_series
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  activity.user_id AS UserId,
  activity.activity_date AS activity_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN activity.type = 'post' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_on_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN activity.type = 'comment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_on_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN activity.type = 'vote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_on_date,
  SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN activity.type = 'post' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) OVER (PARTITION BY activity.user_id ORDER BY activity.activity_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS posts_running_total,
  SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN activity.type = 'comment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) OVER (PARTITION BY activity.user_id ORDER BY activity.activity_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS comments_running_total,
  SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN activity.type = 'vote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) OVER (PARTITION BY activity.user_id ORDER BY activity.activity_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS votes_running_total
FROM (
  SELECT OwnerUserId AS user_id, date(CreaionDate) AS activity_date, 'post' AS type FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT UserId AS user_id, date(CreationDate) AS activity_date, 'comment' AS type FROM comments WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT UserId AS user_id, date(CreationDate) AS activity_date, 'vote' AS type FROM votes WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
) activity
GROUP BY activity.user_id, activity.activity_date
ORDER BY activity.user_id, activity.activity_date
views.description: Daily counts of posts, comments, and votes per user (by CreationDate/CreationDate/CreationDate respectively) with running totals per user ordered by date. Useful for analyzing user activity growth and cumulative contributions over time. | Use for: User engagement over time; Cohort retention (activity accumulation); Detect bursts or declines in individual user activity

views.name: postlinks_edges
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  PostId,
  RelatedPostId,
  LinkTypeId,
  CreationDate
FROM postLinks
views.description: Normalized edge list of links between posts with direction preserved: one row per link where PostId -> RelatedPostId, including LinkTypeId and CreationDate. Use for graph traversals, duplicate detection, or network metrics. | Use for: Build post link graphs and compute connectivity; Find duplicates or related posts via link types; Temporal analysis of links created over time

views.name: posthistory_latest_per_post
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  PostHistoryTypeId,
  PostId,
  RevisionGUID,
  CreationDate,
  UserId,
  Text,
  Comment,
  UserDisplayName,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PostId ORDER BY CreationDate DESC, Id DESC) AS history_rank
FROM postHistory
views.description: Latest postHistory event per PostId (by CreationDate then Id) exposing a rank so consumers can filter for rank=1 to get the most recent history record per post. Useful for retrieving last edit/revision metadata without joining all history rows. | Use for: Get latest revision details per post; Audit recent editors and change summaries; Combine latest history with posts to see last-changed metadata

views.name: tags_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  TagName,
  Count,
  ExcerptPostId,
  WikiPostId
FROM tags
views.description: One row per tag preserving TagName and counts and wiki/excerpt post ids. Use as canonical tag dimension for lookups or to join to posts after parsing posts.Tags externally. | Use for: List tags and popularity; Join tags to their wiki/excerpt posts; Filter tags by usage Count
